violations.text: A variety of breads and cookies packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Observed bags of sugar stored on the floor in the kitchen storage area. PIC placed bags of sugar off the floor at time of inspection. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
